_comment: The videos page: its own copy, then the library. This file is the source: app/videos/page.tsx reads it through lib/local-content.ts and only falls back to the CMS snapshot when it is missing.

seo.metaDescription: Planned walkthroughs of the NHCX integration (onboarding, DevTools, claim workflows, security and certification) with the outline each recording will follow.

page.title: Walkthroughs of the integration, chapter by chapter
page.intro: Nothing has been recorded yet. Each entry below is a planned session with the outline it will follow; the recording replaces the outline when it is published. Webinar materials get their own group as sessions are held.

channelCta.label: Start with the learning path in DevTools

page.featuredTitle: End to end: install DevTools, register a participant, run a coverage eligibility check
page.featuredDescription: The first recording will follow the implementation journey of the learning path, from a fresh install to reading the on_check callback.
page.footNote: Recordings and webinar materials are announced in the news feed.
